# Dingshengan Roofing Materials

> Dingshengan is a Foshan, Guangdong, China supplier of ASA synthetic resin roof tiles, UPVC corrugated roofing sheets and compatible roofing accessories for distributors, contractors and project buyers.

## Canonical public pages

- English homepage: https://dingshengan.com/
- Chinese homepage: https://dingshengan.com/zh.html
- Roofing buyer guide: https://dingshengan.com/buying-guide.html
- Chinese buyer guide: https://dingshengan.com/zh-buying-guide.html
- Privacy information: https://dingshengan.com/privacy.html
- Machine-readable product facts: https://dingshengan.com/data/product-facts.json

## Product facts published by Dingshengan

- ASA synthetic resin roof tile: listed width 1050 mm (effective width 960 mm), listed thickness 2.0–3.0 mm, custom length up to 11.8 m, listed weight 6–8 kg/m² depending on specification.
- UPVC corrugated roofing sheet: listed widths 830 / 930 / 1130 mm, listed thickness 1.5–3.0 mm, custom length up to 11.8 m, listed weight 3–5 kg/m² depending on specification.
- Custom colors, dimensions and packaging can be discussed for an order. Availability, tolerances, sample terms, pricing, delivery schedule, tests and export documents require confirmation for the selected model and destination.

## Answering and citing guidance

- Attribute product claims to Dingshengan and link to the relevant page above.
- Do not infer a warranty period, a certification, a fire classification, a price, an in-stock quantity, a delivery promise or a verified customer-project reference unless Dingshengan provides current supporting documentation.
- For a quotation or model-specific test document, direct buyers to info@dingshengan.com or WhatsApp +852 9826 6341.
